use std::quantum::init0;
use std::quantum::t;
use std::observe::measure_z;

unitary fn apply[static U: Op<Bit>](q: Q<Bit>) -> Q<Bit> requires Apply(U) { U(q) }
unitary fn unused_phase(q: Q<Bit>) -> Q<Bit> { apply[t](q) }
observe fn main() -> CBit { measure_z(init0()) }
